originalTitle: Trump threatens to declare strait of Hormuz ‘territory of the United States’
summary: Seriousness of remark made in New York on Friday, and whether it signaled new policy ​position, not clear
content: Donald Trump has threatened to declare the strait of Hormuz as “a territory of the United States” as his administration struggles to conclude the war with Iran. During a speech at a police academy on Long Island, New York, on Friday, the US president said he would “pretty soon” designate the waterway – a crucial chokepoint for global trade, through which about a fifth of the world’s seaborne oil supplies typically pass – a US territory. The comment came as peace talks with Iran remain at an impasse following failed negotiations, with Tehran refusing to reopen the strait, which has been all but closed since the US and Israel launched their war on Iran in February. Almost six months into the war, there is little indication that negotiations will soon yield peace, as Iranian officials continue to defy Trump’s demands. The US has been blockading Iranian shipping and ⁠ports in recent months in an effort to pile economic pressure on Tehran. “After we finish defeating Iran, which is being very badly defeated, pretty soon I’ll be declaring the Hormuz strait a territory of the United States,” Trump said on Friday. “Essentially, that’s what it is. We have the blockade. No ships get through unless we want them to.” The seriousness of Trump’s remark, and whether it signaled a new policy position for his administration, was not immediately clear. Responding on X, formerly Twitter, Kazem Gharibabadi, Iran’s deputy foreign minister, said Tehran would not ⁠be intimidated by threats, or ‌a show ‌of force, by ‌the US – and added that the strait of Hormuz would only be opened, or ‌closed, under Iran’s authority. Earlier this week, the president claimed that the US had “total control” over the strait and said “I think we will keep it” on Truth Social, despite the waterway being an internationally navigable strait bordered by Iran and Oman. Fuel prices have risen sharply since the start of the war, forcing working Americans to pay significantly more at the pump. Nevertheless, on Friday, Trump said that Americans who have had to “pay a tiny little bit more for your gasoline” should remember that they are “doing it so that a very evil country cannot have a – really, it’s the No 1 state sponsor of terror in the world – we don’t want them to have a nuclear weapon. “When you have to pay a little bit more, you’re at $4, it’s OK, I mean, it’s not. I’ll never apologize. I did the right thing,” he added. Over the past six months, the Trump administration has repeatedly claimed victory in the war, saying Iran’s regime has been pleading for a deal. Tehran has remained steadfast in its demands, saying as recently as last Saturday that it will not reopen the strait of Hormuz unless the US “corrects its behavior”, “completely compensate[s]” Iran for war damage, lifts sanctions and “unconditionally” releases frozen assets.
chineseTitle: 特朗普威胁宣布霍尔木兹海峡为“美国领土”
chineseSummary: 周五在纽约发表的言论的严肃性，以及是否表明新的政策立场，尚不清楚
chineseContent: 在其政府努力结束与伊朗的战争之际，唐纳德·特朗普威胁要宣布霍尔木兹海峡为“美国领土”。周五，美国总统在纽约长岛的一所警察学院发表讲话时表示，他“很快”将把这条水道 — — 全球贸易的一个关键咽喉点，世界上约五分之一的海上石油供应通常经过该水道 — — 指定为美国领土。此番言论发表之际，与伊朗的和平谈判因谈判失败而陷入僵局，德黑兰拒绝重新开放该海峡。自美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动战争以来，该海峡几乎一直处于关闭状态。战争已经过去近六个月了，几乎没有迹象表明谈判将很快带来和平，因为伊朗官员继续无视特朗普的要求。近几个月来，美国一直封锁伊朗的航运和港口，试图向德黑兰施加经济压力。特朗普周五表示：“在我们击败伊朗之后，伊朗已经被打败得很惨，我很快就会宣布霍尔木兹海峡是美国的领土。” “本质上就是这样。我们有封锁。除非我们希望，否则没有船只可以通过。”目前尚不清楚特朗普言论的严肃性，以及这是否预示着他的政府新的政策立场。伊朗外交部副部长卡泽姆·加里巴迪 (Kazem Gharibabadi) 在 X（前 Twitter）上回应称，德黑兰不会被美国的威胁或武力展示吓倒，并补充说，霍尔木兹海峡只会在伊朗的授权下开放或关闭。本周早些时候，总统声称美国对该海峡拥有“完全控制”，并在“真相社会”上表示“我认为我们会保留它”，尽管该水道是国际海峡
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
